name: Yasmin El-Sayed
headline: Finance Analyst | Financial Modeling & Data Analytics
summary: Detail-oriented Finance Analyst with 5 years of experience in financial modeling, budgeting, and data analysis within FMCG and financial services sectors. Skilled in building forecasting models, automating reporting workflows with SQL, and delivering actionable insights to support strategic decision-making.

responsibilities: Develop and maintain complex financial models for annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting
Analyze large datasets using SQL to identify cost-saving opportunities across business units
Prepare monthly management reports summarizing key financial performance indicators
Collaborate with department heads to review budget variances and recommend corrective actions
Built financial models to support pricing strategy and product profitability analysis
Assisted in preparation of consolidated financial statements for regional entities
Automated recurring reports using SQL queries, reducing manual reporting time
Supported audit processes by preparing schedules and reconciliations
Assisted senior analysts in building valuation models for client engagements
Compiled and cleaned financial data from multiple sources for reporting purposes
Prepared basic financial summaries and supporting documentation for presentations
